title: Ashley G FDE 21909 NDE 21909
content: One night, I was riding with three of my friends in my friend Mikey's car. It was I in the back seat behind the driver. My friend JT was next to me. My best friend at the time, Alicia, was sitting in the passenger seat. Mikey was driving. It was a little red car. We were driving around 7:00 pm down a curvy road. I think it was in November because it was already dark. It was raining, but not very hard. We were coming down a hill and at the bottom of the hill was a semi sharp turn to the right. Mikey was driving about sixty-five miles per hour, and I told him to slow down but he didn't. We reached the bottom of the hill and right before the curve, I remember there was an old run down barn to the right. Then when he went to go around the curve, he lost control of the car. I felt like I was standing outside the car on the side of the road in the right in front of the barn. The car seemed to be a hundred feet away. I could see the red car. I could see us in the car, I could see the car spinning and sliding across the wet pavement, and I could see the other cars and their headlights coming from the other way. I kept thinking that they were going to hit the car. It all seemed like it was in slow motion, but I was in normal motion. As soon and the car stopped I was back in the car just sitting there wondering what had just happened. The car never rolled or hit anything. It just spun around a couple of times. We ended up on the opposite side of the road in the ditch facing the other way. We all sat there for a moment. Nobody said anything, and then Mikey just drove off like nothing happened. Still, to this day, I never felt that I was really in the car the whole time it was happening.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Felt like standing outside the car on the side of the road, in front of an old run down barn, with the car about a hundred feet away.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived being outside the car watching it spin/slide in slow motion, then suddenly back in the car after it stopped.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The experience occurred during a car loss-of-control incident where the car did not roll or hit anything; the experiencer felt outside the car ~100 feet away watching the scene in slow motion, then returned to the car when it stopped.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I felt like I was standing outside the car on the side of the road in the right in front of the barn.” / “It all seemed like it was in slow motion, but I was in normal motion.” / “Still, to this day, I never felt that I was really in the car the whole time it was happening.”
